subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Airlines
overview: Fly with Juneyao Airlines to Shanghai and travel through Hangzhou’s West Lake, the water town of Wuzhen and Anji’s Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort. Spend a whole day at Shanghai Disneyland with ticket, transfer and guide included. Four nights in 5-star hotels, with free meal upgrades to Yuyuan hot pot and BBQ.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 1–5 2027 to Feb 16–20 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Starbucks Reserve Roastery Shanghai: A very large Starbucks Reserve coffee roastery known for its roasting theatre and design.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's famous pedestrian shopping street, busy with stores, restaurants and neon lights.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade lined with historic buildings, facing the skyscrapers of Pudong.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's landmark TV tower with its distinctive spheres, seen on a photo stop from The Bund.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous freshwater lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site ringed by hills, pagodas and gardens.
placeDesc.Leifeng Tower: A rebuilt pagoda on the shore of West Lake in Hangzhou, seen on this tour from the outside.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Culture Village: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou famed for Longjing tea; the visit includes tea tasting and a Hanfu experience.
placeDesc.Wuzhen West Gate: The entrance area of Wuzhen's West Scenic Area, a classic Jiangnan water town of canals and old houses.
placeDesc.Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort: A ski resort in Anji, Zhejiang, with ski equipment included on this tour (snow suits not included).
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland: A Disney theme park in Shanghai's Pudong district; ticket, transfer and guide are included for the whole day.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A Taoist temple in Shanghai's old city, set among traditional-style shops and lanes.
